newsitem.title: UK: Six killed as Hurricane Lili tailend lashes UK.
newsitem.headline: Six killed as Hurricane Lili tailend lashes UK.

text.p: Six people were killed when the tail end of Hurrican Lili lashed Britain for three days with winds gusting up to 90 miles (145 km) an hour.
Police, giving an update on casualty figures from the gales, said four people were killed in accidents when storms turned roads into death traps. Two fishermen were swept into the sea off Wales.
British meteorologists said the storms were a spin-off from Hurricane Lili, which caused widespread damage in Cuba and the Bahamas just over a week ago.

Insurers predicted the bill for storm damage could top 150 million pounds ($240 million) after high winds battered the coast, cut electricity, closed bridges and forced ferry cancellations. Even seals and a juvenile whale were washed ashore by the gales. ($1=.6223 Pound)
